summary: Python-only source reader, ledger and lossless Parquet companions for all 488 GT23 recordings. Counts equal the plan exactly: 488 recordings, 4,880 channel files, 787 event files (9 empty), 13,119 windows (7,721 left, 5,398 right), 398 recordings with windows, 90 without. Marker rows equal 200 Hz channel rows in all 488; Raw_EMGs is 2000 Hz (ten rows per 200 Hz row) and is checked that way. 17 recordings lack one of the 22 needed markers (named below). Independent audit of the 12 participant batches NOT yet done.
